particular
enormous
immense

more

Solution: Correct Answer is "more"

☛ "Strong" is irrelevant because it doesn’t collocate correctly with "pertinent".
☛ Grammar Rule: When comparing one thing among others, "more + adjective" is used. Example: "This route is more convenient."
☛ Context Clue: The phrase "a few [dreams]" earlier in the sentence justifies the use of "more" to highlight relative importance.
